headline: AI is the main growth driver but revenue expansion remains uneven across the sector.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Coforge, while Infosys trimmed guidance and Wipro saw profit dip. AI‑related deal wins were highlighted by several firms, but only a few disclosed concrete AI revenue figures.

themes.title: AI‑led deal wins
themes.detail: Multiple firms cite AI pipelines and large‑deal wins as key growth catalysts.

themes.title: Margin expansion
themes.detail: Companies with strong AI revenue reported higher operating margins.

themes.title: Revenue growth divergence
themes.detail: Top line growth varied widely, with low‑single‑digit growth at Infosys versus high‑double‑digit at Coforge and Tech Mahindra.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump and AI revenue of $219 m.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.
